name: Vietnamese Women's Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Phụ nữ Việt Nam
summary: Spend a morning in the galleries of the Vietnamese Women's Museum at 36 Ly Thuong Kiet, south of Hoan Kiem, including a room of women's fashion. It is open every day, so it is the museum to keep for a Monday, when the history and ethnology museums may be closed.
getThere: 36 Ly Thuong Kiet, south of Hoan Kiem
heroCaption: The museum front at 36 Ly Thuong Kiet

notice.title: Open every day
notice.body: The museum is open 8:00 to 17:00 every day, including Mondays.

body: The visit is the galleries at 36 Ly Thuong Kiet, south of Hoan Kiem, including a display of women's fashion. Give it a morning.
It is open 8:00 to 17:00 every day, so it is the safe museum for a Monday. Students and Women's Union members pay half the adult price, and children and school pupils pay a quarter.

figures.caption: The fashion display inside the galleries
figures.alt: Women's fashion on mannequins in a gallery of the Vietnamese Women's Museum

gettingThere: The address is 36 Ly Thuong Kiet. Walk south from Hoan Kiem Lake.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: Walk south to 36 Ly Thuong Kiet.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the visit page.
admissionNote: Adult 40,000 VND. University and vocational students and Women's Union members 20,000 VND. Children and school pupils 10,000 VND (museum visit page, Circular 06/2020/TT-BTC; Vietnam Tourism agrees).
